Two, or one that was not last year

outcomes.text: The rule asks for Class 12 passed in 2026, or appearing in 2027 for the first time. Read the official brochure for any exception.
The rule allows at most two attempts, in consecutive years. Read the official brochure to check your case.
On this rule you can apply. Any Class 12 stream is allowed. Check the official brochure for the details.

outcomes.text: On this rule B.Des is open to Class 12 students of any stream. Check the official prospectus for the other routes and details.

B.F.Tech needs Mathematics, or an engineering diploma. B.Des is open to any stream. Read the official prospectus for your case.
